name: Internal Wireless Reconnaissance
description: Active and passive wireless reconnaissance conducted inside the target after initial access maps internal networks not visible from the perimeter. This includes identifying all SSIDs, BSSID mapping to physical locations, signal strength surveys, and identifying client devices. Conducting this inside the facility reveals internal networks, IoT segments, and management VLANs that support implant placement planning.

blue.det: WIDS detects scanning activity inside facility; probe requests from unknown device; DHCP logs show unknown MAC address.
blue.cm: WIDS deployed inside facility; 802.1X on all wireless; NAC; monitor DHCP logs for unknown devices; segment internal wireless networks.
